2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (microwave/model product). Mask negative/invalid values (swe >= 0).
3. Logic: Check collection size; if 0 after attempts -> C1. Compute valid pixel count on spatiotemporal max image; if 0 -> C2. If any derived metric is null/NaN -> C3. Decide Yes/No using peak SWE at the point (inches).

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1) Geometry & Time
    const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.3273, 39.3177]); // Donner Pass, CA
    const region = point.buffer(2000); // 2 km buffer for stats
    const start = '2022-01-01';
    const end = '2022-05-01'; // end is exclusive

    // Helper to await getInfo
    const getInfo = (eeObj) =>
      new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo(resolve, reject));

    console.log('Location: Donner Pass (-120.3273, 39.3177), Buffer: 2 km');
    console.log(`Period: ${start} to ${end}`);

    // 2) Data Acquisition & Check
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/NOHRSC/SNODAS')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select('swe');
    let n = await getInfo(col.size());
    if (n === 0) {
      // Recovery: widen date window
      const start2 = '2021-12-01';
      const end2 = '2022-06-01';
      col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/NOHRSC/SNODAS')
        .filterDate(start2, end2)
        .filter(ee.Filter.date(start, end)) // keep original target period if available
        .select('swe');
      n = await getInfo(col.size());
      if (n === 0) {
        console.log('SNODAS Images: 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }
    console.log(`SNODAS Images: ${n}`);

    // Mask invalid values (negative)
    const colMasked = col.map((img) => {
      const swe = img.select('swe');
      const valid = swe.gte(0);
      return swe.updateMask(valid).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    });

    // 3) Spatiotemporal max image and region stats
    const maxImg = colMasked.max().rename('swe');
    const countObj = maxImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    });
    const pixCount = await getInfo(countObj.get('swe'));
    const isCountValid = Number.isFinite(pixCount) && pixCount > 0;
    if (!isCountValid) {
      console.log('Valid pixels (peak image) in buffer: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Valid pixels (peak image) in buffer: ${pixCount}`);

    const regionStats = maxImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.max(), sharedInputs: true}),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    });
    const regionMeanMm = await getInfo(regionStats.get('swe_mean'));
    const regionMaxMm = await getInfo(regionStats.get('swe_max'));

    // 4) Peak at the point (to get date and exact local peak)
    const colWithPt = colMasked.map((img) => {
      const v = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: point,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e8,
      }).get('swe');
      return img.set('pt', v);
    }).filter(ee.Filter.notNull(['pt']));

    const validAtPt = await getInfo(colWithPt.size());
    let ptPeakMm = null;
    let ptPeakDate = null;
    if (validAtPt > 0) {
      const top = colWithPt.sort('pt', false).first();
      ptPeakMm = await getInfo(top.get('pt'));
      ptPeakDate = await getInfo(ee.Date(top.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
    }

    // 5) Validation & Final Answer
    // Check for calculation failures
    const badRegion =
      regionMeanMm === null || regionMaxMm === null ||
      !Number.isFinite(regionMeanMm) || !Number.isFinite(regionMaxMm);
    const badPoint = ptPeakMm !== null && !Number.isFinite(ptPeakMm);

    if (badRegion || badPoint) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Convert to inches
    const mmToIn = (mm) => (mm === null ? null : (mm / 25.4));
    const regionMeanIn = mmToIn(regionMeanMm);
    const regionMaxIn = mmToIn(regionMaxMm);
    const ptPeakIn = mmToIn(ptPeakMm);

    // Print concise evidence
    if (ptPeakIn !== null && ptPeakDate) {
      console.log(`Peak SWE at point (in): ${ptPeakIn.toFixed(2)} on ${ptPeakDate}`);
    } else {
      console.log('Peak SWE at point (in): null');
    }
    console.log(`Region mean SWE of peak-image (in): ${regionMeanIn.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Region max SWE of peak-image (in): ${regionMaxIn.toFixed(2)}`);

    // Decision: use point peak if available; else fallback to region mean peak-image vs 40 in
    const threshold = 40.0;
    let decisionVal = ptPeakIn !== null ? ptPeakIn : regionMeanIn;
    if (decisionVal === null || !Number.isFinite(decisionVal)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (decisionVal > threshold) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
